The Season Collection

Winter

Our winter work: quiet prints, paper goods for the giving season, and clothing with some weight to it. We keep the color low and the light warm, the way the season actually feels here.

The winter line

Prints, paper goods, and the warm end of the clothing line, gathered for the cold months. The frame TV art is paintings made for televisions that show art when they are off, like Samsung's The Frame, so the screen hangs on the wall as a picture instead of going black.
